name: Bank of China Limited
summary: Bank of China Limited, alongside its numerous subsidiaries, offers a comprehensive range of banking and financial services, organized into six primary divisions: Corporate Banking, Personal Banking, Treasury Operations, Investment Banking, Insurance, and Other Operations. As of December 31, 2021, the company maintained an extensive network of 10,382 branches and points of presence. Established in 1912, Bank of China Limited has its corporate headquarters situated in Beijing, China.
